subject: Mythology
title: Yurei: Japanese Ghosts
description: A micro-lesson that makes Yurei: Japanese Ghosts usable.

hook.text: Yurei are spirits of the dead who cannot rest, appearing in white burial robes with long black hair over their faces.

buildup.text: They are trapped between worlds by strong emotions: rage, jealousy, sorrow, or a desperate need for revenge.

discovery.text: The most famous yurei is Oiwa, a woman poisoned by her husband who returns as a disfigured vengeful ghost.

twist.text: Yurei cannot be fought or killed. The only way to stop them is to resolve the emotional wrong that binds them.

climax.text: The yurei image — pale face, dark hair, white robes — directly inspired The Ring, The Grudge, and modern horror.

punchline.text: Japanese ghosts do not haunt houses. They haunt the people who wronged them.

quiz.question: What keeps a yurei trapped between worlds?
options: A curse placed on them by a priest
Strong unresolved emotions like rage, jealousy, or sorrow
They forgot the rituals needed to enter the afterlife
